description: Conservative retention of complete licensing files for production dependencies locked by the RapiDoc upstream build; this does not claim every dependency is linked into the minified bundle. The exact shipped bundle and its own extracted notices are pinned separately.

packages.name: @apitools/openapi-parser
packages.limitation: Upstream archive contains only two JS bundles and package.json, which declares MIT and author Mrinmoy Majumdar. No standalone upstream license or copyright notice is published; repository is unavailable. Original declaration and complete standard MIT permission/disclaimer are retained without inventing attribution. This is not independent confirmation of upstream rights.

packages.name: short-unique-id
packages.limitation: Upstream publishes Apache-2.0 declaration and README but no standalone LICENSE; originals are retained with the complete standard Apache text. No missing upstream copyright notice is invented.
